## General safety {#sec:safety-general}

Read this manual before the unit is started and keep it with the machine. The
unit stores compressed air and hot oil, so every service task begins with
stopping the unit, isolating it electrically and venting the pressure.[^1]

[^1]: The maintenance chapter repeats this sequence before each procedure.
